data.body: The new test only covers `gh_add_label` failing. There is no test for the complementary partial-failure state — `gh_add_label` succeeding and the subsequent `gh_remove_label` failing — which leaves an issue with both `needs-info` and `needs-triage` applied. Given the loop aborts the whole run on any `StaleIssueError` (as this PR's own test demonstrates for the add-failure case), add a case (extend `FakeGitHub` with a `remove_label_failures` set, similar to `patch_failures`) asserting `added_labels` contains the pair while `removed_labels` stays empty, and that a subsequent successful run still removes `needs-info` without erroring on the already-present `needs-triage` label.
